name: lifetime-war-tab
why: Opens on a tab for wars in countries you can't find on a map, lands $113,551 in YOU's lap, and pays off with the postman tiptoeing away from his phone.

name: umbrella-causing-the-rain
why: A base drops and grows its own enemies, the attack line pushes Bush's banner off the chart, and YOU discovers his umbrella was making the rain.

name: unblowing-up
why: The factory blows up the hospital and bills for rebuilding it, then Wishonian children laugh at the fable until they learn it is real, and it loses to the recorder by a hair.
